Localized fix: `endpoint()` now treats a known-dead instance like a missing one and respawns (`packages/backend-opencode/src/endpoint.ts`); regression test `endpoint() never hands out a dead owned child; it respawns` in `packages/backend-opencode/test/runtimeLifecycle.test.ts`.
